features.statement: A single system font stack is used throughout, with no web fonts loaded.
H1 is large and bold, about 3.4× body size, tightly tracked, and set in white on a colored hero.
Palette centres on a deep indigo with a single warm amber/yellow accent used for the primary CTA and icons.
Hero background is a diagonal gradient from deep indigo to a lighter violet-blue.
Hero lists several benefits as bullets, each marked with a circular check icon.
Primary CTA buttons are fully rounded pills, amber with dark text in the hero and indigo in the header.
Header is white with logo left and right-aligned dropdown nav items with chevrons plus a pill CTA button.
Content sits in a centred container about 1120px wide on a 1440px viewport.
Link cards in multi-column grids (3 or 4 columns) each show a title and a right-pointing arrow.
Cards have thin light borders, rounded corners, and no shadows, giving a flat look.
Section backgrounds alternate between white and a very pale lavender-grey tint.
Section intro paragraphs are width-constrained to roughly half the container.
Image-topped cards have a media area above a white label strip with a bold title, in a rounded bordered frame.
Section headings are left-aligned and bold navy, with short gray descriptions and generous 60–100px vertical spacing between sections.
Payment brand logos appear as desaturated grey monochrome marks in a hero box and the footer strip.
Image alt texts are descriptive, enumerating all items depicted in logo strips.
Footer is plain: thin top rule, small grey legal text, a couple of indigo text links, and a logo strip.
Page is short and text-light, with little copy.
Copy avoids emoji, exclamation marks and em dashes, using spaced hyphens instead.
Heading outline is a single H1 followed by one H2 per section, with no deeper levels.
Styling lives in a single inline style block with no external stylesheets or inline style attributes, and minimal head metadata.
Layout combines CSS grid and flexbox.
Motion is limited to simple transitions, with no animations, transforms or blur effects.
Border radius uses only square corners, a single 8–15px tier, and pills.
Card heights in a grid row adapt to content, so cards with wrapped titles are taller.
